title: Facial Scrubber
description: A handheld facial scrubber. Ideation started from natural forms, with the curves of a peacock on the first boards, and narrowed through rounds of ergonomic studies to a palm-sized form that sits on the vanity between uses.

brief.label: Process
brief.text: Natural-form ideation (Ideation 1), then hand-held ergonomic studies (Ideation 2), then a final visualization.

brief.label: Design response
brief.text: A rounded, palm-sized form that fits the hand during use and rests upright on the counter.

brief.label: Competition
brief.text: Cleansing devices from FOREO, Philips and Panasonic.
